name: project-agent-test-reason-in-prose
description: A red test's reason written only in the reply text is refused; the refusal names the test, and the testReasons entry shows under the status line as the Agent wrote it.

projectAgent.request: Write a test for the cave before room 5 exists

turns.text: Cave entrance stays red because room 5 has not been built yet.

testReasons.reason: room 5 has not been built yet.

expectedInstructions: testReasons needs one entry for each red test
projectAgent.expectedReply:
1 test fails: Cave entrance
- Cave entrance: room 5 has not been built yet.

Write a test for the cave before room 5 exists
